:::{#exr-rank-factorization-construct-practice}
#### Building a rank factorization from a basis of the column space

@thm-rank-factorization builds a [rank factorization](#def-rank-factorization)
from a [basis](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-basis) of the [column space](#def-column-space).
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & 6 \\ 1 & 0 & 1},
$$

in which [column](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) $3$ is the sum of columns $1$ and $2$.

Find a rank factorization $\matr{A} = \matr{C}\matr{R}$ in which $\matr{C}$ holds [columns 1 and 2 of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

[Column $j$ of](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) $\matr{R}$ says how much of column $1$ and of column $2$ of $\matr{C}$ add up to column $j$ of $\matr{A}$.

:::
